Hey, time to post some out there shit people haven't suggested.

Shantae - Great Metroidvania with a few flaws, but deservedly a well loved GBC game. Emulate this one on PC or 3DS Virtual Console though, cart only copies start at like $200. The sequels on Steam/GOG are overall better games if you want to skip the original

Daikatana - The PC game is considered one of the greatest all-time disappointments of gaming, but the GBC game is a decent top-down adventure game that makes me think of a cyber-punk Legend of Zelda. Only released in Europe though

Super Mario Land 2 - I don't see this one mentioned that much but I really enjoyed it as a kid and again when I found a copy as a teenager. First introduction of Wario and a lot of fun levels and environments

Wario Land 1-3 - The first one is an obvious Mario Land spinoff, and the later two feel more like an adventure platformers with less linear levels and a bigger focus on treasure hunting. If you like the first one, there was also a similar Wario Land game on the Virtual Boy (only one of two VB games worth playing imo)

Solar Striker - The first Shoot em Up that I ever played and a fairly good one, if a bit simple. It was an early Gameboy game though and impressive for the time

Sims (GBA) - Rather fun adventure games that have some elements from mainline Sims games but add in a fairly enjoyable story and world to explore. Bustin' Out, Urbz, and Sims 2 are the GBA games.

All the other games I can think of to suggest (Adventure Island 2 (AI3 on the NES), Lion King, Kid Dracula, Tetris Attack/Puzzle League etc.) have better console ports if you're looking to emulate. Those are worth playing the Gameboy versions if you're going with physical carts though. There are also a ton of SNES remakes on the GBA, but they tend to have washed out graphics and awful sound, so SNES versions are preferred by a lot of people.
